key_idea: Direct simulation of a Hill cipher: pad with spaces to a multiple of n and multiply each block by the matrix mod 37.
sketch: Map A-Z to 0-25, digits to 26-35 and space to 36, pad the plaintext with spaces to a multiple of n, multiply each length-n block by the matrix modulo 37 and map back. O(len * n). Pitfalls: the plaintext line contains spaces (and may start or end with them) so read it with getline and do not trim, and the output may contain spaces too.
